title: A Photonic Integrated Long-distance Quantum Communication Network
abstract: Nature Photonics, Published online: 19 June 2026;

result: Successful demonstration of a four-user quantum network spanning up to 540 km, with full connectivity between any two user pairs.
conclusion: This work represents a significant step toward practical, scalable quantum communication networks, combining photonic integration with a network topology suitable for metropolitan and intercity distances.

title: Restoring Heisenberg Scaling In Time Via Autonomous Quantum Error Correction
abstract: npj Quantum Information, Published online: 15 June 2026;

conclusion: Autonomous quantum error correction is a viable path to achieve Heisenberg-limited metrology in realistic noisy environments, bridging quantum error correction and quantum sensing.
